decisions_this_run: D-077a: per-grant provenance is exposed as an additive detail list, not by changing the holders summary. A fold cannot carry per-grant provenance (three grants, three issuers, three reasons), and replacing holders would break the consumer contract for no gain.
D-077b: both views are projected from one active_grants() tuple at one instant, so summary and detail cannot disagree about which grants are active.
D-077c: the disclosure question NEX-076 raised is answered for operators only. The listing is operator-gated, so the reason reaches the audience that needs it (the auditor) and no wider one.

head_drift_policy: `commit` names the last head whose *product* code was verified by CI, not necessarily the branch tip. NEXUS checkpoint updates are themselves docs-only commits, so the tip advances one commit past `commit` every time this file is written - chasing it is an unbounded loop (run 64 hit this: 7456a89 -> 974d03f -> c49befe, each fix creating a new tip).
